name: RandomBag<T>
src_typeComment: "Shuffle bag" randomizer (the classic Tetris 7-bag technique): guarantees every item is drawn exactly once before the bag reshuffles and repeats, instead of letting pure independent random rolls occasionally streak the same item many times in a row. Use for anything where players would notice and feel cheated by an unlucky streak — which piece/card comes next, which enemy type spawns.
